description: Vozni red HŽ Putničkog Prijevoza u GTFS obliku is a dataset listed in Open Data Portal Croatia, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by HŽ Putnički prijevoz d.o.o.. The data of HŽ Putnički prijevoz on the current train schedule have been published. The data is published with the aim that the interested public can easily read timetable data and use them for creating applications or other research. The data is updated daily, at 01:00. The publisher named on the listing is HŽ Putnički prijevoz d.o.o.. Its keywords include GTFS, vozni red, hž putniki prijevoz. The listing shows 1 download or service links in ZIP. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-portal-otvorenih-podataka.
